local TinyHandler = {}

local TREE_GRAB_ABILITY = "tiny_tree_grab"
local TOSS_TREE_ABILITY = "tiny_toss_tree"
local TREE_GRAB_MODIFIER = "modifier_tiny_tree_grab"
local FAR_TREE_RADIUS = 5000
local FAR_TREE_DURATION = 8
local GRAB_CAST_DELAY = 0.03
local GRAB_CHECK_INTERVAL = 0.03
local GRAB_MAX_CHECKS = 30

local function EnsureAbility(unit, name, level)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    local ab = unit:FindAbilityByName(name)
    if not ab then
        ab = unit:AddAbility(name)
    end
    if ab and level and level > 0 then
        ab:SetLevel(level)
        ab:SetActivated(true)
    end
    return ab
end

local function EnsureState(context)
    context.special_state = context.special_state or {}
    context.special_state.tiny = context.special_state.tiny or {}
    return context.special_state.tiny
end

local function CreateTempTreeNear(origin, forward)
    if not origin or not CreateTempTree then
        return nil
    end
    local dir = forward
    if not dir then
        dir = GoodForward
    end
    if not dir then
        dir = Vector(1, 0, 0)
    end
    local pos = origin + dir * FAR_TREE_RADIUS
    return CreateTempTree(pos, FAR_TREE_DURATION)
end

local function GrabTree(caster, ability, tree)
    if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    if not ability or ability:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    if not tree or tree:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    if ability.IsCooldownReady and not ability:IsCooldownReady() then
        return false
    end
    ExecuteOrderFromTable({
        UnitIndex = caster:entindex(),
        OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET_TREE,
        AbilityIndex = ability:entindex(),
        TargetIndex = tree:entindex(),
        Queue = false,
    })
    return true
end

local function QueueTossTree(caster, ability, enemy, pos)
    if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    if not ability or ability:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    if ability.SetHidden then
        ability:SetHidden(false)
    end
    if enemy and not enemy:IsNull() then
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = caster:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
            AbilityIndex = ability:entindex(),
            TargetIndex = enemy:entindex(),
            Queue = true,
        })
        return true
    end
    if pos then
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = caster:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION,
            AbilityIndex = ability:entindex(),
            Position = pos,
            Queue = true,
        })
        return true
    end
    return false
end

local function SetGrabBusy(context, caster, value)
    if caster and not caster:IsNull() then
        caster.__tiny_grab_busy = value
    end
    if context and context.parent and context.parent ~= caster and not context.parent:IsNull() then
        context.parent.__tiny_grab_busy = value
    end
end

local function EnsureTreeGrab(context, caster, level, enemy, pos, toss_ability)
    if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    if caster:HasModifier(TREE_GRAB_MODIFIER) then
        SetGrabBusy(context, caster, nil)
        return true
    end

    local grab = EnsureAbility(caster, TREE_GRAB_ABILITY, level or 1)
    if not grab then
        SetGrabBusy(context, caster, nil)
        return false
    end
    local origin = caster:GetAbsOrigin()
    local forward = caster.GetForwardVector and caster:GetForwardVector() or nil
    local tree = CreateTempTreeNear(origin, forward)
    if not tree then
        SetGrabBusy(context, caster, nil)
        return false
    end

    Timers:CreateTimer(GRAB_CAST_DELAY, function()
        if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
            return nil
        end
        if not grab or grab:IsNull() then
            SetGrabBusy(context, caster, nil)
            return nil
        end
        if not tree or tree:IsNull() then
            SetGrabBusy(context, caster, nil)
            return nil
        end
        GrabTree(caster, grab, tree)
        local checks = 0
        Timers:CreateTimer(GRAB_CHECK_INTERVAL, function()
            if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
                return nil
            end
            if caster:HasModifier(TREE_GRAB_MODIFIER) then
                if toss_ability then
                    QueueTossTree(caster, toss_ability, enemy, pos)
                end
                SetGrabBusy(context, caster, nil)
                return nil
            end
            checks = checks + 1
            if checks >= GRAB_MAX_CHECKS then
                SetGrabBusy(context, caster, nil)
                return nil
            end
            return GRAB_CHECK_INTERVAL
        end)
        return nil
    end)

    return true
end

function TinyHandler:Init(context)
    if not context or not context.parent or context.parent:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    EnsureState(context)
    if context.parent.GetUnitName and context.parent:GetUnitName() == "npc_dota_auto_cast_dummy_tiny_4" then
        EnsureAbility(context.parent, "tiny_grow", 3)
    end
end

function TinyHandler:PrepareCast(context, profile, enemy, pos)
    return false
end

function TinyHandler:OnAbilityAdded(context, profile, ability)
    if not ability or ability:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    if ability:GetAbilityName() ~= TOSS_TREE_ABILITY then
        return
    end
    local caster = context and context.parent or nil
    if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    local level = ability.GetLevel and ability:GetLevel() or 1
    EnsureAbility(caster, TREE_GRAB_ABILITY, level)
end

function TinyHandler:TakeoverCast(context, profile, enemy, pos, caster, ability, order_type)
    if not profile or profile.is_attack then
        return false
    end
    if profile.projectile_name ~= TOSS_TREE_ABILITY then
        return false
    end
    if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
        return true
    end
    if caster:HasModifier(TREE_GRAB_MODIFIER) then
        SetGrabBusy(context, caster, nil)
        if profile.skill and profile.skill.SetHidden then
            profile.skill:SetHidden(false)
        end
        return false
    end

    SetGrabBusy(context, caster, true)
    local level = profile.skill and profile.skill.GetLevel and profile.skill:GetLevel() or 1
    EnsureTreeGrab(context, caster, level, enemy, pos, ability or profile.skill)
    return true, profile.interval or 0.5
end

return TinyHandler

payload.text:
**Analyzing tree grab mechanics**

The tree grab ability depends on hero-specific animation modifiers and attached tree props, which likely don't work with npc_dota_creature units missing hero attributes like inventory or hero name; the modifier attaches the tree model and triggers hero-based animation sets, so custom units using npc_dota_creature may fail because they lack these hero-linked configurations.

**Identifying ranged attack setting blocking tree grab**

The unit’s AttackCapabilities set to RANGED likely prevents the tree grab modifier from switching animations and attack types properly because ranged units use different activity animations without "tree" variants, blocking both the visual tree attachment and melee attack behavior needed for tree grab.

**Analyzing tree grab issue on dummy units**

The problem likely stems from dummy units missing proper model scaling or variant settings required for the tree grab effect, along with the built-in modifier not activating as expected on custom units despite being added. The tree grab ability depends on a special model change attaching a tree prop, which may rely on specific model attachments or wearables that dummy units lack.

**Identifying melee requirement for tree grab animations**

Tree grab’s model and animation depend on the unit being melee, as the modifier applies a "tree" activity modifier that only triggers for melee idle/attack animations. Custom dummy units set as ranged miss these animations and the attached tree prop, so switching `AttackCapabilities` to melee and removing ranged projectile should enable proper tree visuals and animation.

    if not self.dummy or self.dummy:IsNull() then

local ResolveCastBehavior = autocast_common.ResolveCastBehavior
local ParseAbilityDuration = autocast_common.ParseAbilityDuration
local GetAbilityCastRange = autocast_common.GetAbilityCastRange
local ActivatePassiveAbility = autocast_common.ActivatePassiveAbility
local GetPlayerStats = autocast_common.GetPlayerStats

local DUMMY_SP_UNIT_NAME = "npc_dota_auto_cast_dummy_sp"
local DummySpPools = {} -- Keyed by "pid_category"

local function GetItemCategory(ability)
    if not ability or ability:IsNull() then
        return "default"
    end
    local name = ability:GetAbilityName()
    -- Strip trailing _1, _2, etc.
    local category = string.gsub(name, "_%d+$", "")
    return category
end

local function ReadUnitKV(unit)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    local name = unit.GetUnitName and unit:GetUnitName() or nil
    if not name or name == "" then
        return nil
    end
    return UnitsKV and UnitsKV[name] or nil
end

local function ApplyRangedProjectileFromDummy(target, source)
    if not target or target:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    local kv = ReadUnitKV(source)
    if not kv then
        return
    end
    local projectile_model = kv.ProjectileModel or kv.ProjectileName
    if projectile_model and target.SetRangedProjectileName then
        target:SetRangedProjectileName(tostring(projectile_model))
    end
    local proj_speed = tonumber(kv.ProjectileSpeed or nil)
    if proj_speed and target.SetProjectileSpeed then
        target:SetProjectileSpeed(proj_speed)
    end
end

local function PrepareDummySp(self, dummy, origin)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    local owner = self.owner or self.parent
    if owner and not owner:IsNull() then
        dummy:SetOwner(owner)
        dummy:SetControllableByPlayer(owner:GetPlayerOwnerID(), false)
    end
    if origin and dummy.SetAbsOrigin then
        dummy:SetAbsOrigin(origin)
    end
    dummy.__autocast_destroying = nil
    dummy:SetIdleAcquire(false)
    dummy:SetAcquisitionRange(0)
    if dummy.RemoveNoDraw then
        dummy:RemoveNoDraw()
    end
    if not dummy:HasModifier("modifier_invulnerable") then
        dummy:AddNewModifier(dummy, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
    end
    if not dummy:HasModifier("modifier_phased") then
        dummy:AddNewModifier(dummy, nil, "modifier_phased", {})
    end
    if not dummy:HasModifier("modifier_rooted") then
        dummy:AddNewModifier(dummy, nil, "modifier_rooted", {})
    end
    if not dummy:HasModifier("modifier_no_healthbar") then
        dummy:AddNewModifier(dummy, nil, "modifier_no_healthbar", {})
    end
    if dummy:HasModifier("modifier_dummy_autocast") then
        dummy:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_dummy_autocast")
    end
    if not dummy:HasModifier("modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs") then
        dummy:AddNewModifier(dummy, self.ability, "modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs", {
            prevent_death = 1,
        })
    end
    if self then
        self:ApplyDummySpPassives(dummy)
    end
    if self and self.parent and not self.parent:IsNull() then
        dummy.__autocast_source_dummy = self.parent:entindex()
    end
    return dummy
end

local function AcquireDummySp(self, origin)
    local pid = -1
    local owner = self.owner or self.parent
    if owner and not owner:IsNull() then
        pid = owner:GetPlayerOwnerID()
    end

    local category = GetItemCategory(self.ability)

    for i = #pool, 1, -1 do
        local dummy = pool[i]
        if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then
            table.remove(pool, i)

**Analyzing root cause and fix**

# Dota2 Ability

## Overview

Create or rewrite Dota 2 abilities using KV + Lua, using proven patterns for modifiers, events, projectiles, and API-driven behavior.

## Workflow

1) Decide the change type
- Pure data change: edit KV only.
- Behavior change: add or modify Lua.
- Awakening override: add awakening modifier + KV entry.

2) Update KV
- Locate the hero KV in `scripts/npc/heros_ability/`.
- Add or edit the ability block and `AbilityValues`.
- Keep value formats consistent with the existing file.

3) Update Lua
- Place ability scripts in `scripts/vscripts/hero/hero_<name>/`.
- Add modifiers and link with `LinkLuaModifier`.
- Use `GetIntrinsicModifierName` for passives.
- Use `OnAbilityFullyCast` for extra casts or multi-target logic.

4) Apply project-specific extensions (optional)
- If the project uses an awaken-style system, follow its override and registry rules.
- Otherwise keep changes within KV + Lua and the standard ability/modifier flow.

## Guidance

- Prefer KV edits for numbers; use Lua for behavior changes.
- Avoid hardcoding numbers in Lua if the KV can express them.
- Gate difficulty scaling with `GameRules:GetCustomGameDifficulty()`.
- Use `Timers:CreateTimer` for sequenced effects; avoid global state.
- Keep logic server-side; guard with `if not IsServer() then return end`.

## Task Mapping

- "Adjust numbers by difficulty" -> KV scaling or project-specific override logic.
- "Make ability passive" -> `GetIntrinsicModifierName` + intrinsic modifier logic.
- "Add extra casts/targets" -> `OnAbilityFullyCast` + dummy caster or manual calls.
- "Rewrite projectile behavior" -> create projectiles and handle `OnProjectileHit`.
- "Add new ability" -> KV block + new Lua ability file + LinkLuaModifier.

## References

- Dota 2 ability overview: `references/dota2-ability-overview.md`
- Ability KV format: `references/ability-kv-format.md`
- Lua patterns and hooks: `references/lua-ability-patterns.md`
- Awaken examples (project-specific): `references/awaken-ability-examples.md`

## Assets

- Ability templates (KV + Lua + optional awakening modifier): `assets/ability-template/`

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:BuildConfigForAbility(ability, parent)
    if not ability or not parent then
        return nil
    end

    local raw_kv_withlevel = AbilityKV[ability:GetAbilityName()]
    if not raw_kv_withlevel then
        return nil
    end

    self.lvl = GetTrailingIndex(ability:GetAbilityName())
    self.custom_level = tonumber(ability.custom_level) or tonumber(self.lvl) or 1

    local raw_kv = raw_kv_withlevel
    local effect_overrides = nil
    if raw_kv_withlevel and Shop1EnhanceManager and Shop1EnhanceManager.GetOverrideValues and ability.raw_name then
        local pid = parent:GetPlayerOwnerID()
        local base_item_kv = Shop1ItemsKV and Shop1ItemsKV[ability.raw_name]
        local overrides = Shop1EnhanceManager:GetOverrideValues(pid, ability.raw_name, self.custom_level,
            base_item_kv)
        if overrides then
            effect_overrides = overrides.__effect_overrides
            overrides.__effect_overrides = nil
            raw_kv = NewTable(raw_kv_withlevel)
            raw_kv.AbilityValues = NewTable(raw_kv_withlevel.AbilityValues or {})
            for key, value in pairs(overrides) do
                if raw_kv.AbilityValues[key] ~= nil then
                    raw_kv.AbilityValues[key] = tostring(value)
                else
                    raw_kv[key] = value
                end
            end
        end
    end

    self.hero_name = raw_kv.HeroName
    self.projectile_name = raw_kv.ProjectileName

    if self.projectile_name == "" then
        return raw_kv
    end

    self.reveal_delay = DEFAULT_REVEAL_DELAY

    local config = autocast_item_config.Read(raw_kv)
    local base_item_kv = Shop1ItemsKV and Shop1ItemsKV[ability.raw_name] or nil
    if not base_item_kv and Shop1ItemsKV and Shop1ItemsKV["Shop1 Items"] then
        base_item_kv = Shop1ItemsKV["Shop1 Items"][ability.raw_name]
    end
    local career = NormalizeCareer(base_item_kv and base_item_kv.Career)
    config.career = career
    local effects = autocast_item_config.ReadEffects(base_item_kv, self.custom_level, "Effect")
    local additional_effects = autocast_item_config.ReadEffects(base_item_kv, self.custom_level, "AdditionalEffect")
    if effect_overrides then
        if effect_overrides.replace and #effect_overrides.replace > 0 then
            effects = effect_overrides.replace
        end
        if effect_overrides.additional and #effect_overrides.additional > 0 then
            additional_effects = additional_effects or {}
            for _, entry in ipairs(effect_overrides.additional) do
                table.insert(additional_effects, entry)
            end
        end
    end
    config.effects = effects
    config.additional_effects = additional_effects
    for key, value in pairs(config) do
        self[key] = value
    end

    return raw_kv
end

To fix, add the tree wearable (497) to dummy units’ definitions to ensure the model displays when the modifier activates; for animation issues, verify the modifier is actually applied, since without it the animation won’t switch.

Using skill `dota2-ability` because this is a Tiny ability/animation behavior tied to KV + engine modifiers.

The precise issue I can point to in your data: the tree wearable (ItemDef `497`, “Tiny’s Tree” in `items_game.txt`) is not attached to the dummy units. In `npc_dota_auto_cast_dummy_tiny_1`~`_3` it’s explicitly commented out, and in `_4`~`_6` it’s missing entirely. Without that wearable, the engine has no tree model to show when `modifier_tiny_tree_grab` is applied, which is why you never see the tree and the tree-variant animation set won’t present correctly.

Changes applied (attack type left untouched as you requested):
- Un-commented ItemDef `497` for tiny_1~3 and added it for tiny_4~6 in `game/dzsj/scripts/npc/units/npc_dota_auto_cast_dummy.txt`.
- Mirrored the same changes in `game/dzsj/scripts/npc/npc_units_custom.txt`.

If you want me to also add a quick debug print to confirm `modifier_tiny_tree_grab` is actually applied to the dummy at cast time, I can do that next.

**Planning visual grab modifier**

I'm outlining a new modifier to manage the tree grab visual, including applying the "tree" animation translate and attaching/removing the wearable prop dynamically. It'll be a separate modifier with creation and destruction hooks, linked in tiny.lua near the grab logic, to keep concerns isolated and handle both animation and visuals cleanly.

I'm preparing to add a new hidden modifier that spawns and follows the tree wearable on grab, handles animation translation, and auto-removes itself when the grab ends. This involves linking the modifier in tiny.lua, adding removal of default wearables from relevant KV files to avoid conflicts, and applying/removing the modifier based on tree grab state inside the grab handler timer.

+modifier_tiny_tree_grab_visual = class({})
+
+local TREE_MODEL = "models/heroes/tiny/tiny_tree/tiny_tree.vmdl"
+local TREE_GRAB_MODIFIER = "modifier_tiny_tree_grab"
+
+function modifier_tiny_tree_grab_visual:IsHidden()
+    return true
+end
+
+function modifier_tiny_tree_grab_visual:IsDebuff()
+    return false
+end
+
+function modifier_tiny_tree_grab_visual:IsPurgable()
+    return false
+end
+
+function modifier_tiny_tree_grab_visual:GetAttributes()
+    return MODIFIER_ATTRIBUTE_IGNORE_INVULNERABLE
+end
+
+function modifier_tiny_tree_grab_visual:OnCreated()
+    if not IsServer() then
+        return
+    end
+    local parent = self:GetParent()
+    if not parent or parent:IsNull() then
+        return
+    end
+
+    local wearable = SpawnEntityFromTableSynchronous("dota_item_wearable", {
+        model = TREE_MODEL,
+    })
+    if wearable then
+        wearable:AddEffects(EF_BONEMERGE)
+        wearable:FollowEntity(parent, true)
+        self.tree_wearable = wearable
+    end
+
+    self:StartIntervalThink(0.1)
+end
+
+function modifier_tiny_tree_grab_visual:OnIntervalThink()
+    local parent = self:GetParent()
+    if not parent or parent:IsNull() then
+        self:Destroy()
+        return
+    end
+    if not parent:HasModifier(TREE_GRAB_MODIFIER) then
+        self:Destroy()
+    end
+end
+
+function modifier_tiny_tree_grab_visual:OnDestroy()
+    if not IsServer() then
+        return
+    end
+    if self.tree_wearable and not self.tree_wearable:IsNull() then
+        UTIL_Remove(self.tree_wearable)
+        self.tree_wearable = nil
+    end
+end
+
+function modifier_tiny_tree_grab_visual:DeclareFunctions()
+    return {
+        MODIFIER_PROPERTY_TRANSLATE_ACTIVITY_MODIFIERS,
+    }
+end
+
+function modifier_tiny_tree_grab_visual:GetActivityTranslationModifiers()
+    return "tree"
+end
*** End Patch

Using skill `dota2-ability` because this is Tiny ability behavior driven by KV + Lua.

You’re right: putting the tree wearable in KV makes it show from spawn, which is wrong. The correct behavior is runtime-only: attach the tree when `tiny_tree_grab` is active and remove it when the modifier ends. I implemented that explicitly.

What changed and why
- Removed the static `ItemDef 497` tree wearable from the Tiny dummy KV so the model starts without a tree.
  - `game/dzsj/scripts/npc/units/npc_dota_auto_cast_dummy.txt`
  - `game/dzsj/scripts/npc/npc_units_custom.txt`
- Added a runtime visual modifier that:
  - Spawns the tree wearable model only while `modifier_tiny_tree_grab` is present.
  - Applies the `tree` animation translate so idle/walk switch while holding the tree.
  - Cleans up automatically when the grab ends or the tree is thrown.
  - `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/modifiers/modifier_tiny_tree_grab_visual.lua`
- Hooked it into the Tiny autocast handler right after grab succeeds:
  - `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/projectiles/autocast_specials/tiny.lua`

This gives the exact desired flow:
- Default state: no tree, default animations.
- After `tiny_tree_grab`: tree appears in hand, animations switch to tree set.
- Toss/charges end: tree removed, animations return to default.

If you want, I can also add a small debug print so you can verify `modifier_tiny_tree_grab` and `modifier_tiny_tree_grab_visual` lifecycles in-game.

If you still see the tree not following or aligning, I can switch to `SetParent` + `FollowEntity` combo, but I didn’t want to change more until we verify this fix.
